additional_info.subject: RE: ID0414563-DC/Si-D/BE-[MP / R6 170002120] memory moduledefective CRM:02679000015
additional_info.body:
Dear Erik,
I am writing to formally inform that we are moving case 0414563 ﻿from the
eMobility DC Queue (Level 2)
to the
eMobility RC-BE SI E Queue (Level 2)
, due to one or more following reason (s):
As per the picture customer has shared, I suspect that either the CFast card is damaged or PLC is unable to detect the CFast card.
I would recommend you to please carry both Cfast and PLC as spare and first try to insert the new card if it can be detected by the PLC. If Cfast was found defective then you have perform the Cfast flash with new one and restore config to setup the cfast for the charger.
SIMATIC CFAST Memory Card 128 GB > 6ES7648-2BF10-0XM1
ET200 Open Controller Linux > 6ES7677-2DB40-0AA0
Reason
Applicable
Onsite Repair (Component Exchange)
✔
Onsite Troubleshooting
✔
End Customer Communication
✔
Spare Part Ordering
✔
Performance monitoring by RC
Kindly pick up the case using "
Pick
" option in the queue or manually using the "
Assign
" function from the
eMobility RC-BE SI E Queue (Level 2)
and work on it & document the activity (Logs/Field Service Report) and attach it to the Notes in the case timeline or under documents Tab on ISP.
In case you require expert support, kindly create Work-order as per
unified service process
.
If you need assistance with ordering Expert Support, feel free to reach out to Sousa, Afonso (SI E CS SD) at
afonso-sousa@siemens.com
or Teodoso, Rui (SI E CS SD ES) at
rui.teodoso@siemens.com
.
Kindly close the case post resolution and send survey email to the customer.
Thank you.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team - Vishal Dhiman
